## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 284 captures during April 2021. Activity was delivered as part of the clinic’s routine imaging service, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported total provides the activity level for the month and includes all captures completed at the site.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 10 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.5 per cent. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be graded. Ungradable images remain part of the site’s quality monitoring and should continue to be reviewed through normal operational processes.

## Grading

There were 51 referable results during April 2021. The median grading lag was 1 day. This records the midpoint of the time taken for grading and provides an indication of the service’s grading turnaround for the month. Activity, image quality and grading results should be considered together when reviewing the site’s performance.
